mod.name: TB Survivor Luck
mod.summary: A gambling-style mod where players win items by scratching a scratch card. You decide the symbols, how often each wins and which items they give.
mod.notes: The sample file has empty reward lists, so no prize is given until RewardOptions are filled. How players obtain cards is not described in the docs; the card item has its own types entry (TBSLScratchCard). Admin rights come from Global/AdminConfig (survivorLuck).

files.title: Scratch card prizes
files.summary: Symbols of the scratch card, the chance of each to win and the items it pays out.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

WinningCombinations.label: Winning combinations
WinningCombinations.help: The possible outcomes of a scratch card, one entry per symbol. Each has a win chance and one or more reward sets.

WinningCombinations[].label: Combination
WinningCombinations[].help: One symbol with its win chance and rewards.

WinningCombinations[].ImageSymbol.label: Symbol
WinningCombinations[].ImageSymbol.help: Picture shown on the card for this outcome. Only the nine built-in symbols exist.

WinningCombinations[].Chance.label: Win chance
WinningCombinations[].Chance.help: How likely this symbol is to be a winner, from 0 to 100. Higher values hand out its rewards more often.
WinningCombinations[].Chance.risk: High chances on valuable rewards will flood the server with loot.

WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations.label: Reward variations
WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations.help: Alternative reward sets for this symbol. One set is picked at random when the symbol wins.

WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].label: Rewards (deprecated)
WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].help: Old reward list, marked for removal. Use RewardOptions instead and leave this empty.

WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].label: Reward options
WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].help: The items given to the player when this variation is picked.

WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].label: Item class
WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].help: Class name of the item given as a prize (case-sensitive).

WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].label: Quantity
WinningCombinations[].RewardVariations[].help: How full or how much of the item is given, 100 meaning full.
